author: candycamper357
body:
Hey my ign is Ninja1977
I have been falsely accused of hacking on avicus for click aim bot or auto click.
I was not hacking and I would like to be Unbanned, I do not have any proof that I wasn't but I can go on and show yous.
I am a gold donater and this was my first ever minecraft server and I've known it for my all entire mine craft life which is around 2 years, which it really sucks that I'm banned on it now
And yes to be completely honest I went on my other account BlueTNT_PvP to try and say I wasn't hacking but got banned for ban evading and also AutoKillSwitch
i would just like to say sorry for ban evading but I wasn't hacking.
i hope to get unbanned or turn this into a tempban.

Thanks, Ninja1977

replies.author: Ironsoldier2000
replies.body:
Alright, the staff team has come to a verdit. After discussing for the lengthy time of your appeal, we have decided that as you ban evaded you will not be unbanned. Whether the evidence is false or not, is not a question as you did ban evade. We do not accept ban-evasion on Avicus, hence your ban will remain. You may appeal in a few months time.

Thanks, 
Iron, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
